protocol.scope: Real frontend editor with deterministic browser-routed mock API and synthetic authentication; no real backend, native executor or provider.
protocol.budgetScope: Actions, autosave and heap sampling; observer disposal/reporting use the remaining 90-second test ceiling.
protocol.actionWallTiming: Includes automation, assertions and the mock autosave debounce; not a processing/paint latency.
protocol.clocks: Actions use Node monotonic time; heap/EventTiming use browser monotonic time from probe installation. These nearby origins are not identical.

fieldINP.reason: A finite automated laboratory interaction sample is not field INP.

limitations: Heap values are optional nonstandard browser JS-heap estimates, may be coarse or shared, and exclude whole-platform/native memory.
The page, instrumentation and browser runtime contribute to the heap; this does not isolate editor allocation.
One 40-second schedule cannot establish a leak, absence of leaks, long-term capacity, a speedup or a population latency distribution.
EventTiming is thresholded and may be empty, rounded, unsupported or truncated. No latency or heap-size acceptance threshold is imposed.
